animeDescription: In a world where humanity is on the brink of extinction due to man-eating giants, Eren and his friends join the military to fight back and uncover dark secrets.
A high school student discovers a mysterious notebook that allows him to kill anyone by writing their name in it, leading him into a deadly moral conflict.
Two brothers use alchemy in their quest to find the Philosopher’s Stone and restore their bodies after a tragic accident.
After his family is slaughtered by demons and his sister is turned into one, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps to avenge them and find a cure.
In a world where nearly everyone has superpowers, a powerless boy dreams of becoming a hero and is mentored by the world's greatest superhero.
Each generation of the Joestar family faces bizarre adventures filled with supernatural abilities, ancient curses, and unforgettable villains.
A high school student becomes a vessel for a powerful curse and joins a secret organization to fight against supernatural threats.
